notes: Parties: on the Play page, Create Party gives you a code to share, and friends type it into Join Party (up to four of you, on any platform). The leader presses Casual and the whole party finds a game together, on one team: a running game with room for all of you, else other players, else bots after a minute. Play Again keeps the party together, and the party lasts between matches.
Competitive is gone from the Play page for now: it comes back once there are enough players to fill its games.
